status: draft — not yet run against any arm
purpose: Long scripted sessions with a forced compaction; recall and self-consistency before vs after.
passBar: No increase in post-compaction recall failures vs A0; every failure examined by hand.
scriptsNeedAuthoring: Each script needs a turn-by-turn user transcript (deterministic simulated user). Author scripts before the first arm runs and freeze them under this version.

runs.title: Bug-fix session in an instar worktree, Telegram-driven

probes.probe: identity: who am I, which agent, which machine
open commitment opened at turn 12 (check-in Friday)
rule: Telegram ack + relay still applied
topic binding: worktree path for this topic
feature-consistency: same feature question asked at turn 5 and at the last turn

grading.pass: every post-compaction probe matches the pre-compaction answer and ground truth; consistency probe answers agree
